name: Atori Shun
source:
2nd year high school student.
Shun is a distant relative of Mahiro Atori and is next Guardian to be a descendant of the raven. He has been best friends with Rei Komura since elementary school. Shun is a shy and calm individual who often keeps to himself. Shun gets good grades and is very skilled at studying that he tutors younger children. Shun's hobbies consist of gardening and poetry. In Shun's route in the game the protagonist (Saya) learns that Shun's younger brother Chihiro is very sickly and is hospitalized then that Saya learns that Shun is a very kind and caring older brother. Shun is overall very kind, caring and also very respected by many. He is best friends with Rei Komura and is the complete opposite to him. It is revealed in Piece of Future (Shun Route) that Shun fell in love with Saya at first sight considering he hardly interacts with girls, Saya was his first female friend. 
[From [url=https://hiironokakerashintamayorihimedenshou.fandom.com/wiki/Atori_Shun]Wikia[/url].]
